question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Final answer: percentage of customers who have rented films featuring top 5 actors
WITH top5_actors AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa USING (actor_id)
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT fa.film_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
count_renters AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS renter_count
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top5_actors)
),
count_all AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM customer
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * cr.renter_count / ca.total_count, 2) AS percentage
FROM count_renters cr, count_all ca;
